scenes.title: At night the lion council sits around the round
scenes.text: At night the lion council sits around the round table and debates who will recover the stolen heart stone, and Leo volunteers.

scenes.title: At dawn in his workshop Leo tinkers with clockwo
scenes.text: At dawn in his workshop Leo tinkers with clockwork gears and turns the crank of a music box that points toward the thieves.

scenes.title: At dawn a prison train thunders across the plain
scenes.text: At dawn a prison train thunders across the plains while Leo, captured by the thieves, escapes over the roofs and leaps from the bridge into the river.

scenes.title: Downstream Leo paddles a raft through the rapids
scenes.text: Downstream Leo paddles a raft through the rapids between the boulders of the canyon river.

scenes.title: At noon a herd of wild horses gallops along the
scenes.text: At noon a herd of wild horses gallops along the river toward the mountains.

scenes.title: Leo rides a horse galloping across the plains an
scenes.text: Leo rides a horse galloping across the plains and jumps the fence.

scenes.title: At the foot of the mountains Leo climbs a sheer
scenes.text: At the foot of the mountains Leo climbs a sheer cliff to rescue a lost cub and swings across the gap on a rope.

scenes.title: At dusk an avalanche thunders down the snowy mou
scenes.text: At dusk an avalanche thunders down the snowy mountain and Leo outruns it with the cub.

scenes.title: At dusk a wall of water floods the valley below
scenes.text: At dusk a wall of water floods the valley below and Leo rescues a child and carries it to the hill.

scenes.title: At sunset Leo rides a dragon through the canyon
scenes.text: At sunset Leo rides a dragon through the canyon between the rock spires and under the stone arch.

scenes.title: In a storm Leo fights a sea serpent on the mast
scenes.text: In a storm Leo fights a sea serpent on the mast of a sailing ship.

scenes.title: At night a stolen dinosaur egg lies in a prehist
scenes.text: At night a stolen dinosaur egg lies in a prehistoric valley beside a glowing volcano and Leo carries it back to its mother.

scenes.title: At midnight Leo sneaks into the museum past the
scenes.text: At midnight Leo sneaks into the museum past the laser gate and the sentries and steals the jewel before the alarm sounds.

scenes.title: At dawn an army besieges the citadel with catapu
scenes.text: At dawn an army besieges the citadel with catapults and Leo opens the gate.

scenes.title: At noon in the gladiator arena Leo faces the riv
scenes.text: At noon in the gladiator arena Leo faces the rival lion in a duel before the roaring crowd.
